prerequisites: methods of signal theory and probability theory

learning_outcomes.text: Provide students with the fundamental knowledge and methodological tools required to understand and analyze digital signal processing systems and techniques.

Describe and apply the main methods for the deterministic analysis of one-dimensional signals and systems, with particular attention to audio signals, biomedical signals, and data acquired from advanced sensing systems.
Understand the role of probabilistic and statistical models in the analysis of signals affected by noise.
Apply acquired knowledge and skills to wireless and biomedical signal processing to address real-world problems involving signal analysis and interpretation.
Justify methodological choices adopted and communicate the results of the analysis appropriately.

syllabus_topics: Finite impulse response (FIR) and infinite impulse response (IIR) filters design
Simulation and analysis of random sequences
Estimation of the autocorrelation function of a sequence
Lab Introduction to signal processing using Matlab
Simulation and analysis of random variables
Estimation of CDF from iid sequences
teaching_methods: Computer for numerical exercises and analysis

assessment_methods.method: First part (analytical and methodological aspects, application of signal and system analysis methods)
Second part (discussion of homework, application of numerical signal processing techniques using a computer, interpretation and critical discussion of results and methodological choices)

assessment_rules: The exam consists of two parts: the first accounts for 70% of the final grade and the second for 30%. The overall assessment considers theoretical content, ability to develop and justify analytical procedures, use of numerical tools, and clarity of presentation.
bibliography: Fabio Rocca. Fondamenti di elaborazione numerica dei segnali. CUSL. Milano. Appunti del docente.
degree: Laurea in Ingegneria Elettronica E Biomedica (Electronics And Biomedical Engineering), classe L-8 Classe delle lauree in Ingegneria dell'informazione
